Notice under Section 07
My No.: WGSWD&EIP/ACQ/KB/11. Land Min.’s Ref. No.: 4/3/10/2012/LRB/96.

I hereby give notice under Sub section (1) of Section 7, of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the below mentioned allotments of lands for making a water reserve in Boralesgamuwa paddy field under Weras Ganga Storm Water Drainage and Environment Improvement Project.
